name: Execution Profile Derangement
description: Replaces the artificial dot-product vector rule with a domain-natural concurrency constraint. Instead of vectors, tasks are assigned execution profiles representing resource access sequences. The model must deduce that avoiding resource collisions at every step (P_u[k] != P_v[k]) exactly corresponds to assigning distinct Profile IDs. This hides the 3-coloring equivalence without introducing the contrived mathematical recurrences that triggered the G4 rejection.
